Ruth, I couldn't set up the daily brief. Nothing will post at 07:45 tomorrow until the scheduler is working.

The setup delegate can see the cause, but a fix means changing the Gateway's auth settings and restarting it. I haven't made that change, since it needs someone with Gateway admin rights to approve it.

The job I would create is ready: a cron at 07:45 America/Chicago every day, starting 2026-10-15. It would post a "Strategic pod brief" here covering new messages in #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford. It would skip money terms and finance documents. I'll retry once the Gateway is reachable, or an operator can run the same setup. Tell me if you'd rather have me post the brief by hand each morning in the meantime.
